notes:
**Backtests were running on data they never had.** Three separate
layers were hiding the same failure, and together they meant every
backtest in the app ran on a single session while printing a longer
window on the report. Fixed: history is fetched in chunks your broker
will accept, and the report states the span it actually covered. On a
real account that is the difference between 60 candles of this morning
and 4,520 going back to May.

**The rule you tested is now the rule that runs.** Reports were
produced on 5-minute candles while a deployed rule read 1-minute ones,
which makes it a different rule â€” different crossings, different times,
different trades. A strategy now carries one candle size, you choose it
on the build screen, and both use it.

**A stop that gets jumped now costs what it really costs.** When a
candle opens past your stop, that price was never available again. The
test used to pretend you got it anyway.

**Options are priced on the option.** Each signal is valued on the
premium of the contract it would really have bought, and any signal the
data cannot price honestly is left out and counted rather than
estimated â€” including ones where the listed contract was not the expiry
your rule would have chosen that day.

**Coach can read your patterns.** It joins its own observations
together and tells you what they add up to: your habits, never what to
trade. Uses your own AI key, and only those lines leave the phone.

**Also:** rules can sell first as well as buy; futures roll onto the
next contract by themselves; commodities and equity are available; and
every deployed rule has a Live screen listing every trade it has taken,
what it is holding, and why a signal did not become a trade.
